items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Krasikovsky the copyright expert and he had just gotten three hundred thousand for Chuck Berry?

ctx.x: Some few acknowledged some of the major ones but I've been here long enough, as I've said I've been here six years and I certainly know that they sit for hours and listen to these black performers.
I went to a lawyer recently about something. Krasikovsky the copyright expert and he had just gotten three hundred thousand for Chuck Berry?

Oh, they got more than that, but it took three years to get it. And also it was from the Beatles. Because you know the Beatles had been ripping him off a lot. But they like him so much and everything so they came to the hearing to court, /and said yes, they, they wanted him to win. In other words, /But they couldn't give it out of their pocket because it was the publisher. They wanted him to pay, right? He was collecting all of the money, from some of it. So the publisher had to pay for it as well as them. So…
